meta.title: Paola & Azarias — Our Wedding
meta.description: Join us in celebrating the wedding of Paola Odimba and Azarias Lubobo.

bio.paola: An interior architect in Kinshasa, Paola designs homes you never want to leave. She laughs loudly, dances without warning and believes a good coffee fixes almost everything.
bio.azarias: An engineer by day and a pianist by night, Azarias is calm, funny and loyal. He always has a melody ready for the big moments.

story.title: A story written in the rain and the stars

meeting.title: A storm over Kinshasa
meeting.text: A sudden downpour on campus, a single umbrella, and two strangers laughing as they share the same shelter. He offers to walk her home. They talk until nightfall.

love.title: An “I love you” under the stars
love.text: A power cut, the family terrace and a sky full of stars. In the dark, Azarias finally found the words.

proposal.title: The yes by the river
proposal.text: At sunset over the Congo River, with their families hidden behind the palm trees, Azarias goes down on one knee. Paola says yes before he finishes his sentence.

forever.title: The most beautiful day
forever.text: Two families become one. We want to share this moment with those who carried us and made us laugh. You are part of our story.

customary.title: Customary Wedding
customary.text: Families gather for the traditional dowry ceremony.

civil.title: Civil Wedding
civil.text: The official union, surrounded by our loved ones.

religious.title: Religious Wedding
religious.text: The vows and the nuptial blessing.

footer.thanks: Thank you for celebrating with us

together.title: For life
together.quote: I chose you yesterday, I choose you today, I will choose you always.
